Monologue: I killed a boy by accident, once. I didn't understand that some people could possibly… could ever not have enough food.
He fed his family and me, and I gave them a drink of Aperia. And I asked, "What's the next course?" He died facedown in dinner and bile.
Svetka is no longer going to betray me. She's changed plans. I don't care. I don't think she can really, truly understand why I don't care.
I hate her. Everything she wants is in her hands. Even you. I hate her. I …. I …. I …. I hate her. I …. Hate her.
I … hate …. her…. I … hate …. you … I …. HATE…
